I couldn't get a list of UPS Access Points near Spring, TX. UPS's own location finder returned "No Results Found" for both "Spring, TX" and "Spring, TX 77373". That may be a limitation of the page, so I can't say whether any Access Points exist there.

**What UPS says Access Points offer** (from ups.com's UPS Access Point page):
- **Retail Partners:** local businesses where you can drop off or pick up eligible UPS packages.
- **The UPS Store:** full-service locations with package drop-off and pickup, plus packing, shipping, printing and business services.
- **Redirecting packages:** with a free UPS My Choice account, you can send eligible packages to an Access Point instead of your home.
- **Delivery alerts and tracking:** UPS My Choice also gives you these.

The UPS Store locator lists these services at each location:
- **Packing and shipping:** domestic, international and freight shipping, custom and moving boxes, packing supplies, and Certified Packing Experts.
- **Printing and copying.**
- **Mailboxes:** package acceptance from all carriers, mail notifications, and a street address rather than a PO Box.
- **Other services:** shredding, notarizing and faxing.

Hours and services vary by location, so call ahead to confirm. The UPS app, or the locator on ups.com with a full street address, may show the retail-partner Access Points that I couldn't pull up.
